% A test for tex8web: the \qedsymbol in force where the box is set, whether
% a proof ends in text or in a display: amsthm's, thmtools' qed= for a
% theorem style, one an environment sets, and one set in the text. An
% earlier proof keeps its own.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm,thmtools}
\declaretheorem[qed=$\diamond$]{remark}
\newenvironment{example}
  {\pushQED{\qed}\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{$\triangle$}\par}{\popQED\par}
\begin{document}
\begin{proof}
Plain text.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}
Plain display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{proof}
\begin{remark}
Remark text.
\end{remark}
\begin{remark}
Remark display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{remark}
\begin{example}
Example text.
\end{example}
\begin{example}
Example display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{example}
\renewcommand{\qedsymbol}{$\blacksquare$}
\begin{proof}
Changed text.
\end{proof}
\begin{proof}
Changed display.
\[ a = b \qedhere \]
\end{proof}
\end{document}
